subject: Re: Collaboration proposal — SummitX stage + demo pod bundle
messages:
From: Elena Rhodes <elena@summitxevents.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sponsorships@summitxevents.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitX 2026 — curated sponsor bundle and speaking opportunity

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for taking a quick intro last week. Attaching our standard prospectus (SummitX_2026_Sponsorship_Prospectus.pdf) with package options. We think Redwood is a great fit for our "Cloud + Infrastructure" track and would love to confirm a bundle that includes:

- 10'x10' demo pod near the expo entrance
- branded lounge placement in the partner alley
- 15-minute stage slot in the Cloud track (session title TBD)
- two complimentary conference passes and access to the VIP networking dinner

A few notes: exhibit placement and stage time are tied to package level. There is some flexibility to swap booth location for an upgraded speaking time if that's of interest.

Can you share if there's appetite to pursue the bundle as-is, or whether you'd prefer a custom swap (e.g., demo pod + extra speaking minutes, or a co-branded workshop instead of a stage slot)?

I can also circulate a draft addendum for any agreed swaps; we do this frequently to keep the master contract clean.

If useful I can put together a short visual of the floorplan showing the demo pod sightlines.

Best,
Elena Rhodes
Senior Sponsorship Manager
SummitX Events

Attachments: SummitX_2026_Sponsorship_Prospectus.pdf (59KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Rhodes <elena@summitxevents.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitX 2026 — curated sponsor bundle and speaking opportunity

Elena —

Appreciate the prospectus and the quick follow-up. A couple of clarifying questions before we loop legal/procurement:

1) Speaking time: the deck lists a 15-minute slot. If we trade booth proximity for +10 minutes (25 total) and a brief 5-minute AV demo on stage, would that be an acceptable swap or do you only permit minute-adds within the package tiers?

2) Logo placement: can you confirm tiered logo sizes/placements across the main stage hero banner, mobile app, and on-site directional signage? We need exact pixel/physical specs to sync with our brand guidelines.

3) Demo pod specifics: what power / internet provisioning is included by default vs. add-on? We run continuous device demos and prefer redundant ethernet.

4) Timeline & signoff: assuming we agree on a swap, what is the typical turnaround for an addendum + DocuSign?

Looping Marissa (VP, Marketing) and Ben (Head, Partnerships) for alignment on comms and ops. High level, our preference is live demo visibility and executive stage time rather than additional pass counts.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
T: (415) 555-0192

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitX 2026 — curated sponsor bundle and speaking opportunity

Quick internal note —

Agree with prioritizing stage + demo visibility. A few negotiation guardrails:

- Avoid exclusivity clauses for the lounge or demo pod (they limit demo kit flexibility).
- Require an explicit on-stage AV run-of-show and a guaranteed projector/resolution spec; if they can't provide ethernet redundancy we should contract for a bonded cellular backup (we'll absorb cost).
- If they offer a +10 minute extension, ask that the extra time be non-commercial (no competitor slots adjacent) and confirm a short pre-session promo call with the track chair.

Ben — can you draft a short negotiating play (2 bullets) we can pass to Elena so they can prepare the addendum?

Marissa Cole
VP Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rhodes <elena@summitxevents.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, sponsorships@summitxevents.com
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitX 2026 — curated sponsor bundle and speaking opportunity

Hi Aditya / Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the clear direction — excited you're leaning toward stage + demo priority. Quick answers and next steps:

- Swap: we can trade demo pod sightline for +10 minutes (25 total) and allow a 5-minute AV demo slot (we'll list "demo" in the session format).
- Logo placement: main-stage hero gets prominent logo (3000x600px raster on the stage backdrop file), app tile uses vector logo (512x512), directional signage uses 18" x 24" logo plates; we'll send an art spec PDF with exact margins.
- Power / connectivity: standard package includes 20A single-phase + shared venue Wi-Fi; dedicated ethernet and redundant circuits are add-ons — I attached the floorplan and costed options.
- Addendum & signoff: attached Addendum_RevA.pdf captures the swap and our standard non-exclusivity language. DocuSign packet is live: https://app.docusign.com/packets/9f8e7d-sign. If you can sign by Tue, Mar 9 we can lock the demo pod location on the floorplan.

Attachments: SummitX_Addendum_RevA.pdf (12KB), floorplan_level1.png (420KB)

Let me know if you'd like a 20-min call tomorrow to run the run-of-show with our AV lead.

Best,
Elena Rhodes
Senior Sponsorship Manager
SummitX Events
